Hi Sarah —

Hope you had a good weekend. We’re preparing a short reference packet to support the OliveTech renewal that highlights the measurable outcomes from the past 12 months. The customer success and commercial teams expect this packet will be included in the renewal deck and shared with your procurement/leadership as part of the expansion justification.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the headline outcomes we discussed in the Q3 review (reduced inference cost per query, 45% faster p99 latency for core model, 3x throughput for batch jobs)? If you can, please paste the final numbers into the attached Outcomes_template.xlsx.
- Please confirm we have permission to use the following in the packet: company name, a 2–3 sentence quote, and the Q3 outcome metrics. If Legal needs a formal release, please let us know and we’ll route a DocuSign.
- If you have any internal case study or customer-facing metrics (PDF or short one-pager), attach that too — it will go in the appendix.

We’re aiming to finalize the packet by end of day Tuesday (Nov 30) to align with the renewal presentation on Dec 3. Vivek and I will follow up on slide placement and any extra approvals.

Thanks again for partnering on this — these concrete numbers make a big difference during renewal conversations.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note. I attached a short Q3 outcomes PDF and filled the template with the numbers we track internally. Summary below to make it easy:

- Inference cost per query: down 38% YoY (savings attributed to batching + caching changes)
- P99 latency for production chat path: 45% faster (from 1.8s to 1.0s)
- Batch throughput (nightly processing): 3.2x increase in tokens/sec after Dedicated capacity tuning
- Measured accuracy (semantic rerank): +2.5% NDCG on core workloads

We’re happy for Redwood to reference OliveTech as a customer and use the three bullets above + company name. For a public quote, we’d like to provide a one-line quote from our Head of ML (I can get that by Tuesday). For any legal release, please route to OliveTech Legal (legal@olivetech.com).

Attached: OliveTech_Q3_outcomes.pdf (internal summary)

Sarah
Sr. Product Manager, Data & AI
OliveTech
sarah.lin@olivetech.com
